up: Retrieve activity data for compounds tested against the target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4439 (human TGF-beta receptor type 1). Return the following information: the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, and the PubMed ID or DOI of the source document. Also include the assay description, activity standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target preferred name, and target organism. Filter for records where the activity standard type is 'IC50', the standard units are 'nM', a canonical SMILES exists, and the source document has either a PubMed ID or a DOI.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  act.standard_type,
  act.standard_relation,
  act.standard_value,
  act.standard_units,
  act.activity_comment,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities act
JOIN assays ass ON act.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON act.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4439'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
